name: background-snow-layers
title: Snow
description: Tuyết rơi lắc lư theo vài lớp sâu: bông xa nhỏ và chậm, bông gần to và nhanh.

moworks.author: moworks

credit.author: Moworks Studio
credit.madeNote: the studio's own motion, written here

moworks.notes: 50 flakes with a seeded depth d 0.4-1: fall speed 55 x d px / s (on a 220 px frame: far ~4 s, near ~2 s per fall), radius 1 + 3 d px, sway 10 x d px on sin(1.5 t + i); near flakes (d > 0.8) in the accent, others grey; linear, wrapped for a seamless loop. Params: count (50) · fall (2–4 s) · sway (10 px) · seed.
